title: Baidu joins Alibaba in raising prices for its AI computing power-related services by ~5% to 30% and its parallel file storage system by 30% from April 18 (South China Morning Post)
summary: South China Morning Post: Baidu joins Alibaba in raising prices for its AI computing power-related services by ~5% to 30% and its parallel file storage system by 30% from April 18 — The Chinese firms' price increases are ‘a reasonable response to evolving market conditions’, says IDC China analyst Cui Tingting
